headSHASemantics: This is the exact implementation and test commit. The following documentation-only evidence commit does not change production or test code.
scope: Bounded Excalidraw and JSON Canvas JSON artifact matching, deterministic valid and malformed fixtures, deterministic registry selection, and host-owned Source fallback for malformed artifacts.

success: The Excalidraw signature requires type excalidraw, version 2, and an elements object array.
The JSON Canvas signature requires nodes and edges object arrays.
The registry selects each matching descriptor independently of registration input order.
error: Malformed JSON, an unsupported Excalidraw version, and non-array Canvas fields do not match.
A malformed artifact has no registry match even when its MIME type and extension route to a renderer.
boundary: RendererMatchInput rejects the same oversized sniff before it stores bytes.
coverage.cancellation: Not applicable. This slice has no task, session, or asynchronous operation.
coverage.teardown: Not applicable. This slice allocates no retained resource.

bidirectionalResolution.command: inventory=plans/dynamic-renderers-phase6-matcher-test-inventory.json && jq -e '(.productionPaths | length > 0) and (.testPaths | length > 0) and all(.productionPaths[]; ((.path | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.symbols | type == "array" and length > 0) and (.tests | type == "array" and length > 0))) and all(.testPaths[]; type == "string" and length > 0)' "$inventory" >/dev/null && while IFS= read -r listedPath; do test -f "$listedPath" || { echo "inventory production path is missing: $listedPath" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '.productionPaths[].path' "$inventory") && while IFS= read -r listedPath; do test -f "$listedPath" || { echo "inventory test path is missing: $listedPath" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '.testPaths[]' "$inventory") && while IFS= read -r testName; do functionName=${testName##*.}; matches=$(rg -l -F "func ${functionName}(" $(jq -r '.testPaths[]' "$inventory") | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$matches" -eq 1 || { echo "inventory test did not resolve exactly once: $testName" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '[.productionPaths[].tests[]] | unique[]' "$inventory")

excluded: Excalidraw viewer package and WebView UI
JSON Canvas decoding and native UI
honestCoverageLimits: These tests identify only bounded format signatures. They do not validate complete Excalidraw or JSON Canvas documents.
No renderer descriptor is registered in the app yet. JSON Canvas stays out of the closed built-in factory map until its native view exists.
No hosted WebKit, appearance, accessibility, link, pan, zoom, or session test is in this slice.
